title: Wood Kiln Community Firings (Ongoing)
host_org: Tyler Park Center for the Arts
source_quote: Our community firings are split in-to "Shares." In addition to the loading/prep and unloading/clean up days, we would like to have everyone participate in two stoking shifts of at least 4 hours OR 1 stoking shift of at least 7 hours if it is not possible to get back and forth to the kiln multiple times during the firing.
evidence_sentence: The page describes ongoing community firings available in shares where participants contribute loading, stoking shifts (minimum 4–7 hours), and unloading.
evidence_quote: Kiln firings are scheduled periodically throughout the year.
summary: Community shares in ongoing wood firings; participants bring bisqued and glazed ware, contribute loading/prep, 4–7 hour stoking shifts, and unloading. Contact director@tylerparkarts.org to schedule.
bring: Bisqued and glazed cone-ten stoneware or porcelain ware
commitment: Loading/prep, two 4-hour stoking shifts (or one 7-hour shift), and unloading
how_to_join: Contact director@tylerparkarts.org to schedule a firing date
